# opnsense_auth_privilege (Data Source)

Who holds one privilege (System > Access > Privileges).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `privilege` (String) Privilege ID, e.g. `page-all`.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Set of String) UUIDs of groups holding it.
- `id` (String) Same as `privilege`.
- `users` (Set of String) UUIDs of users holding it.
